entries.assessment: The official RDMDB catalogue individually names the global temperature/salinity decode, global wind decode, regional subsurface decode, separate subsurface decode-error, wind decode, separate wind decode-error and version2 wind products. entries.limits: An archive filename, download host, or data-receipt/collection by JMA alone would not establish creator credit. This catalogue is only the exact-product crosswalk to the separately credited derived-product manuals.
